accessibility.description: The iOS game uses an integrated accessibility layer for VoiceOver. AppleVis reports readable text and labeled controls, but some players encountered startup or privacy-prompt problems and needed to toggle VoiceOver or use the app's system settings. A May 2026 player report confirms DogLife remained accessible despite a separate BitLife regression.
